# Berkshire Safety Consultants — Health & Safety Consultancy

> Expert, practical health & safety consultancy for housing associations and small businesses across Berkshire and the UK. Advice that protects your people, not just box-ticking. Based in Maidenhead, Berkshire.

Berkshire Safety Consultants makes health and safety straightforward — from Building Safety Act and CDM 2015 Principal Designer duties to fire risk assessment, CHAS accreditation, staff training, and compliance management. We give straight answers and tailor support to each client.

## Services

- [Our Services](https://www.berkshiresafetyconsultants.com/services): Overview of tailored H&S solutions across all sectors we serve.
- [Housing Associations](https://www.berkshiresafetyconsultants.com/housing-associations): Fire risk assessments, Building Safety Act guidance, tenant/staff wellbeing, and repairs & maintenance safety.
- [Small & Medium Businesses](https://www.berkshiresafetyconsultants.com/small-businesses): General H&S assessments, CHAS accreditation support, workplace risk management, and H&S/HR integration.
- [Principal Designer Services](https://www.berkshiresafetyconsultants.com/principal-designer-services): Principal Designer duties under CDM 2015 and the Building Safety Act for the pre-construction phase.
- [First Aid & Fire Marshal Training](https://www.berkshiresafetyconsultants.com/first-aid-fire-marshal-training): Accredited on-site training delivered in partnership with British Red Cross Training.
- [Staff E-Learning](https://www.berkshiresafetyconsultants.com/e-learning): Role-specific accredited online H&S courses from the iHASCO library.
- [BSC Assure](https://www.berkshiresafetyconsultants.com/assure): All-in-one compliance management platform — ISO standards, CHAS, Constructionline, policies, and audits in one system.
